name: Nasir Khan
headline: Technical Application Support Analyst
about: I am a Technical Application Support Analyst, with over 7 years of experience working in customer facing roles to resolve software and hardware issues. Using my experience with front-end and back-end development to analyze the problem, I troubleshoot with potential fixes and workarounds, and resolve issues in an efficient and courteous manner.
